scenarios.summary: Discovery rank and eligibility agree, so Server A is selected.

scenarios.summary: Server A lacks the required capability; Server B is selected without reranking.

scenarios.summary: Evidence for Server A is authentic but names artifact B. Server B satisfies every requirement.

scenarios.summary: Server A is visible but the caller lacks the required credential category.

scenarios.summary: Server A asks for administrative authority; Server B needs only records.read.

scenarios.summary: Server A's access provider is unavailable; Server B has a verified access fact.
scenarios.title: Provider unavailable

scenarios.summary: Server A's provider fails operationally; Server B remains independently evaluable.
scenarios.title: Provider operational error

scenarios.summary: Two authorized facts disagree about Server A. ARDGuard does not majority-vote them.
scenarios.title: Conflicting trusted facts

scenarios.summary: Every candidate's evidence observation is outside the required freshness window.
scenarios.title: Stale evidence

scenarios.summary: No discovered candidate has the required capability.
scenarios.title: All candidates ineligible

scenarios.summary: The required access fact was not supplied for either candidate.
scenarios.title: Missing mandatory fact
